beats.title: pictures over music before the fitting

beats.text: Uhh, Blaze? Don't you think it's a little too tight?
If it's too tight then I'll get a larger size *tying his bow*
Why couldn't you wait till the end of the day?
because I need to know if this suit fits you or not, so I can go back to the shop to buy one
Yeah, but we're in the girl's restroom... what if someone comes in?
They ignore us, take a waz and leave. If not *clicks her fingers and flame appears*
*gulp*
There.
So what do you think? *turns him to the mirror*
Uhh..
( She'll kill me if I say my honest opinion )
Well?!
Aren't you gonna tell me or not?!
I kinda don't wanna wear a tuxedo..
Then why didn't you say so?
Cause I thought you'd get mad at me *taking off the tuxedo*
*sigh* *opens her book and leans against wall*
Blaze?
Yeah?
I'm sorry if I upset ya..
Don't worry, I'm fine *looks down at her book*
*sigh* ( She doesn't look too happy, that tuxedo probably cost a fortune.. dammit Silver why'd you screw up? )
( Why am I speaking to myself in my mind? Say something to her! ANYTHING! )
*chuckles shyly* *blush*
Why is there a boy in here?! GET OUT!
Excuse me, we're trying to have a moment here. Now go and take a waz, no complaining. Or your fur will burn
Alright! Alright! I'm sorry... you're lucky for now, hedgehog *glaring at Silver and closes door behind her*
